snippet.title: vpro documentary
snippet.description:
VPRO Documentary publishes a new subtitled documentary every two weeks, investigating current affairs, finance, sustainability, climate change or politics and once in a while a personal story. 
Subscribe to our channel for great subtitled recent documentaries. 
The French and Spanish subtitles are co-funded by the EU and produced in collaboration with Ericsson. 

For our Dutch fans: De VPRO is vanwege de Nederlandse wetgeving genoodzaakt dit kanaal te blokkeren binnen Nederland. Al onze docuemntaires zijn te zien via NPO Start: https://npostart.nl.

VPRO Broadcast: https://www.youtube.com/vprobroadcast
VPRO World Stories: https://www.youtube.com/vproworldstories
VPRO Extra: https://www.youtube.com/vproextra

For more information on VPRO: http://www.vprobroadcast.com

snippet.title: ニコニコニュース文化部
snippet.description:
多彩なカルチャーが集まるトークバラエティch『ニコニコニュース文化部』
美術・科学・旅行・サブカルチャーなど、幅広いジャンルの「教養/エンタメ」動画を配信中。専門家やゲストを招いたディープな解説＆トークをお届けします！ ※旧「ニコニコ美術館」チャンネルがジャンルを拡大してリニューアル

▼配信ラインナップ▼
〇ニコニコ美術館
　博物館や美術館の展示を学芸員の解説といっしょに楽しむ鑑賞会

〇ニコニコバスツアー
　バスガイドさんの解説付きでおじさんが観光地をめぐる素人系旅番組

〇ニコニコサイエンス
　研究機関にお邪魔して科学・化学の世界をのぞき見る大人の社会科見学

〇怪談×民俗学
　怪談を民俗学的な視点で考察する深くて怖いアカデミックなトーク番組

〇にゃるらと夜更かし
　『NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE』のにゃるらがゲストとサブカルを語る夜話

番組はどしどし追加予定！

snippet.title: İhlas Haber Ajansı
snippet.description:
TR:
İhlas Haber Ajansı (İHA) Türkiye’nin her bir il ve ilçesinden, dünyanın ise 35 ülkesinden görüntü, fotoğraf ve haber geçebilme yeteneğiyle haberlerini abonelerine uydu ve internet üzerinden göndermektedir. Türkiye’nin ilk özel haber ajansı ve görüntülü haber servisi yapan ilk ajansı olan İHA, 1993 yılında kurulmuştur. 
 
EN:
Ihlas News Agency Co. (İHA)
Operating with 950 permanent employees and independent contractors at 145 offices in Turkey and abroad, IHA (İhlas News Agency) produces an average of 250 images, 2,000 news reports supported with pictures, and 3,500 photographs per day.

snippet.title: NC Newsline
snippet.description: NC Newsline is a nonpartisan nonprofit news organization dedicated to fearless reporting and hard-hitting commentary that shines a light on injustice, holds public officials accountable, and helps improve the quality of life for all North Carolinians. Founded in 2004 as a small commentary nonprofit known as NC Policy Watch, our newsroom was renamed in 2023 to reflect its evolution into a full-service digital outlet that connects readers and listeners to important news and opinion from across North Carolina and the nation. NC Newsline is an affiliate of States Newsroom, a national 501(c)(3) nonprofit supported by grants and a coalition of donors and readers. NC Newsline retains full editorial independence.

snippet.title: Cash Investigation - France Télévisions
snippet.description:
Cash Investigation est une émission de France 2, présentée par Elise Lucet.

Le magazine d’enquête de France 2 propose à chaque numéro de nombreuses révélations sur des dossiers brûlants.

Ses enquêtes s'intéressent au monde des affaires et ses côtés les moins connus en mettant en lumière des pratiques marketing potentiellement abusives, des dérives de grandes entreprises, des stratégies de détournement de l'argent public, des comportement d'évasion fiscale, des actions d'influences menées par des lobbies voire la manipulation de l'information par des conseillers en communication.

Une production de l'agence de presse Premières Lignes. 

Pour toute information à nous communiquer : info@pltv.fr

專業財經媒體第一選擇，帶您掌握全球財經重要趨勢與觀點洞察。
《工商時報》創刊於1978年12月1日，是一份積極報導經濟事務、國際貿易、國際財經、兩岸財經、投資理財、股市分析為主軸的專業財經報紙，創刊40多年來，以一貫堅持的新聞理念，追求優質新聞報導，深獲華人地區專業經理人的肯定與青睞，更是企業經營者不可不閱讀的專業財經媒體。

snippet.description:

snippet.title: The Electronic Intifada
snippet.description:
The Electronic Intifada is an independent online news publication and educational resource focusing on Palestine, its people, politics, culture and place in the world. 

Founded in 2001, The Electronic Intifada has won awards and earned widespread recognition for publishing original, high-quality news and analysis, and first-person accounts and reviews. The Electronic Intifada’s writers and reporters include Palestinians and others living inside Palestine and everywhere else that news about Palestine and Palestinians is made.

snippet.title: TheMetropolisPlanet
snippet.description:
The Metropolis Planet, established in 1865, is a weekly newspaper located in Metropolis, Illinois, the official hometown of Superman.  The Planet records the action from the Metropolis City Council meetings and the Massac County Commissioners meetings and we post them right here on our YouTube channel.  In addition to the meetings, we at times, record other breaking news events and other fun things, such as special events from the popular Superman Celebration and post them here.
If you like the videos we post, please share our channel with other people and let them know about the Metropolis Planet's You Tube channel!
